title: Degreewise epimorphism property of relatively flat single base change
statement: Let Y, B and A be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p : Y → B quasi-compact and quasi-separated, M a quasi-coherent module on Y [pqf-def-coherent] flat over p [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], g : A → B, and n an integer. In the standard derived localization [def-pc-derived-category], the degree-n cohomology map of the explicitly defined canonical comparison β_(p,M,g) [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map] is a epimorphism of module sheaves on A. This is solely the epimorphism assertion in this one degree.

proof.text: At an arbitrary point a of A, obtain bounded-above flat stalk counit coordinates for the actual canonical comparison. This is the geometric affine/source-open computation, isolated without asserting epicity.
The model complex is K-flat by bounded-above termwise flatness. The universal scalar-extension counit is therefore invertible at this complex.

Apply degree-n homology and conjugate by the model isomorphisms. The displayed square identifies this invertible map with the stalk of H^n(beta), which is therefore surjective. The existing epi_of_surjective_stalk criterion yields epicity on A.

lean.statement:
theorem standard_flat_single_baseChange_homology_epi
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) n).map
        (standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g))
